title: Time-decaying urgency policy
description: Compresses ladder rung TTLs as a forecast breach closes. Urgency changes how fast the ladder is walked; it never changes whether an unattended execution is allowed.

lead_time_factor.description: The k in effective_ttl = min(rung.ttl, k * remaining_lead_time). Capped at 1 so urgency can never hand a rung more time than the lead it has.

min_forecast_confidence.description: A forecast below this confidence does not compress anything. A noisy point estimate must not shorten a human's window.

min_effective_ttl_seconds.description: Starvation floor. Compression never drives a rung below this, so a human is always given a usable window.
